# Paulo Sanches

> Paulo Sanches’s personal portfolio: technology leadership, solution architecture, business transformation and practical AI, with first-hand career experiences and personal principles.

## Portfolio

- [English portfolio](https://paulosanches.github.io/hello/): Profile, experience, Field Notes, Mindset, Contributions and Certifications. Also available in Italian and Brazilian Portuguese. Original personal quotes and official credential names are preserved, with explanations in the selected language.
- [Italian portfolio](https://paulosanches.github.io/hello/it/): The same portfolio in Italian.
- [Brazilian Portuguese portfolio](https://paulosanches.github.io/hello/pt/): The same portfolio in Brazilian Portuguese.
- [Detailed site guide](https://paulosanches.github.io/hello/llms.txt): A concise index of the portfolio’s public content and sources.
- [A week at the beach. A security incident on day two.](https://paulosanches.github.io/hello/field-notes/security-at-the-beach/): Paulo’s first-hand account of a production security incident involving Liferay Portal, architecture decisions and leadership under pressure.
- [I flew to Brazil’s largest bank with a few bullet points as my brief.](https://paulosanches.github.io/hello/field-notes/banking-handover-in-brasilia/): A two-week handover in Brasília, aligning stakeholder expectations, working around a shared PC and addressing the client’s priorities after losing a night’s unpublished work. Also available in Italian and Brazilian Portuguese.
- [We built a system to support families after Brumadinho.](https://paulosanches.github.io/hello/field-notes/supporting-families-after-brumadinho/): A team of six built and supported a system for social workers assisting families after the January 2019 disaster. A first-hand account of team mobilisation, evolving requirements and trust built on an earlier project. Also available in Italian and Brazilian Portuguese.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/paulosanches): Public contact channel.
- [Sitemap](https://paulosanches.github.io/hello/sitemap.xml): Canonical public page URLs.
